title: Build Arena Project Model (frozen-v1)
description: FROZEN CONTRACT. The minimal, deterministic, git+filesystem-grounded decomposition that the intake scorecard and repo-goal loop consume to rank repository requirements and improvements. Every field here is load-bearing: it is read by arena/project_intake_scorecard.py. additionalProperties is false everywhere on purpose — the deterministic core cannot grow silently, and any semantic/AI enrichment must live in a SEPARATE sidecar artifact, never inside this object. Introducing a new schemaVersion or a new REQUIRED field is a breaking change that requires an explicit operator action (see the AGENTS.md boundary rule), not an autonomous agent edit.

id.description: Hex digest (sha256/blake2b) of the canonical model content with this field excluded. MUST be identical across two runs on an unchanged repo HEAD. This is the determinism anchor.

headOid.description: git rev-parse HEAD of the decomposed checkout. Ties the model to a verifiable commit.

tool.description: Generator identity, e.g. 'arena.onboard@<version>'. NEVER a timestamp or wall-clock value.

nodes.description: Every tracked file and directory in the repo, one node each. Sorted by id for determinism.

id.description: Stable id derived from path (e.g. 'node:' + path). Deterministic.

path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path. No leading slash, no '..' segments.

edges.description: Static dependency edges between file nodes (e.g. Python imports resolved to in-repo files). Required as a key so the contract is stable; MAY be an empty array in the first frozen cut before edge extraction lands. Used for impact/blast-radius ranking.

components.description: The decomposition: named groupings of file nodes. Deterministic from path grouping (top-level surface) in the frozen cut. Sorted by id.

kind.description: Optional structural label derived deterministically from path: one of 'code'|'tests'|'docs'|'fixtures'|'config'|'scripts'|'other'.

owned_node_ids.description: File node ids owned by this component.

check_ids.description: observable_checks ids that cover this component. Empty == no observable check (drives the 'untested component' finding).

observable_checks.description: Concrete, runnable checks discovered in the repo (test files / configured commands), mapped to the components they cover.

command.description: Runnable check command if derivable, e.g. 'pytest tests/test_scorer.py'.

verification_gaps.description: Mechanically-derivable gaps where the repo asserts/expects something it does not verify. Each gap is a ranking input. The arena-calibration fixture MUST yield kind 'patch_generalization_axis_missing' for F3_bad_passes_tests (manifest-derived).

path.description: Repo-relative path the gap is anchored to, when applicable (e.g. 'fixtures/F3_bad_passes_tests').

unclassified_node_ids.description: File node ids not owned by any component. COVERAGE-CLOSURE INVARIANT (enforced by the acceptance test): { all file node ids } == union(components[].owned_node_ids) UNION unclassified_node_ids, with empty intersection. A non-empty list is an honest 'unclassified surface' signal — never a silent drop. This is the deterministic 'thoroughness' guarantee.

componentProfiles.description: One profile per component, carrying a deterministically-derived riskLevel. The rule (see implementation plan) is transparent, not model-produced: high == owns code with zero checks; low == checked or non-executable (docs/config/fixtures); medium otherwise.

provenanceRefs.description: Refs (rule id, manifest path) justifying the riskLevel. Optional but recommended for auditability.

qualityGates.description: Repo-wide safe local checks (lint/type/test/build) discovered deterministically from config (pyproject, Makefile, etc.). Empty drives the 'no quality gates' high-severity finding.

openQuestions.description: Optional. Mechanically-surfaced ambiguities (e.g. a declared-but-absent target). Drives an architecture finding. Omit or leave empty in the frozen cut if no deterministic source exists.
